name: Action Against Hunger USA
mission: Action Against Hunger’s mission is to save the lives of children and their families. We are there for them before and after disaster strikes. We enable people to provide for themselves, see their children grow up strong, and for whole communities to prosper. We constantly search for more effective solutions, while sharing our knowledge and expertise with the world. We push for long-term change.
theoryOfChange: Action Against Hunger USA has a published 'International Strategic Plan (2021-2025)' which serves as a strategic framework. This document provides a shared direction and framework for their work over five years, outlining how they will achieve their vision of a world without hunger. It details their goals and the targets they aim to achieve, focusing on long-term change through mitigating key drivers of hunger, including climate change, gender inequality, conflict, and poverty. The plan describes a multisectoral approach to address the immediate, underlying, and root causes of undernutrition and its effects. Action Against Hunger USA, as part of the global network, explicitly refers to and links this International Strategic Plan on its website.

rich_narrative.summary: Action Against Hunger USA is a large-scale humanitarian organization focused on eliminating hunger through the prevention and treatment of undernutrition. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">$160,756,238 in total revenue</cite> to support its global operations. The charity is recognized for its high financial efficiency, maintaining a <cite id="15">program expense ratio of 89.7%</cite>, which ensures that the vast majority of donor funds reach those in need. Their fundraising operations are notably lean, spending only <cite id="15">$0.04 for every $1 raised</cite>.
